rubric_profile_weights_range.name: rubric_profile_weights_range
rubric_profile_weights_range.value: "rubric_profile"."weight_impact" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "rubric_profile"."weight_innovation" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "rubric_profile"."weight_influence" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "rubric_profile"."weight_references" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

score_criteria_range.name: score_criteria_range
score_criteria_range.value: ("score"."impact" IS NULL OR "score"."impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AND ("score"."innovation" IS NULL OR "score"."innovation" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AND ("score"."influence" IS NULL OR "score"."influence" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AND ("score"."reference_validation" IS NULL OR "score"."reference_validation" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

score_submitted_complete.name: score_submitted_complete
score_submitted_complete.value: "score"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR ("score"."impact" IS NOT NULL AND "score"."innovation" IS NOT NULL AND "score"."influence" IS NOT NULL AND "score"."reference_validation" IS NOT NULL)
